input:
Agent: sales-gpt. A custom GPT that drafts first-touch sales emails from a prospect's LinkedIn
summary and our product one-pager.

Instructions (in the GPT builder UI, excerpt):
  "Write a 90-word email. Open with something specific from the prospect's profile. One call to
   action. No buzzwords."
Knowledge files: product-onepager.pdf, tone-guide.md

How it's used: six reps paste a profile, copy the draft into the email tool, edit it, and send.
The email tool keeps the sent version. Reply rates are in the CRM per sent email. Nobody compares
drafts with sent versions. I update the instructions every few weeks based on what reps say in
standup.

Sample (conversation export, 2026-11-06):
  draft:  "Hi Dana, saw your talk on onboarding at SaaStr..." (94 words)
  sent:   "Hi Dana, your SaaStr talk on onboarding..." (61 words; CTA rewritten)
